title: Aagaya abbas
body:
Bar sare dosh haram
tha wo saqqa e haram
janib e neher chala
uthe adaa ke qadam
saniye shere khuda
ban ke aaya hai qaza
har taraf shor utha
aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
saniye shere khuda, ban ke aaya hai qaza
har taraf shor utha, aagaya abbas...
<<DIVIDER>>
Misle taweez e wafa, mashk ko saath liya
boli panje ki chamak, marhaba swalle a'laa
al-amano al azal, door tak hadd e nazar..(2)
abu talib ka jigar, hashmi rashk e qamar
kaatne zulm ka sar, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Khair maqdam ko badhi, alqama sue jari
shor sahil se utha, aagaya ibn e ali
chod ke ghaat chalo, shamiyo bhaag chalo..(2)
dekho ab saans na lo, sher har jaa hai suno
sathiyo se ye kaho, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aks e haider hai yehi, misle jafar hai yehi
zarb e hamza ki qasam, mas'ad e narr hai yehi
baniye shehr e wafa, dil e zehra ki dua..(2)
karne aaya hai wigha, chahiye jisko qaza
saamne aaye zara, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haath mein tegh nahi, phir bhi larza hai zamee'n
sang sab khaak hue, chup gaye darr ke laee'n
naiza shamsheer bana, ghaiz jab had se badha..(2)
mai sakina ka chacha, khadim e shahe hoda
aayi gardu'n se sada, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Dharas e tishna laba'n, bazu e shahe zama'n
pyase bacho ke liye, mustaqil nauha kuna
paani chullu mein liya, yaad aaqa ko kiya..(2)
janib e khaima chala, aayi parcham ki hawa
pyase bacho ne kaha, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayi awaaz e jari, ya hussain ibne ali
dum hai seene mein ruka, chhid gayi mashk meri
jald aao mai chala, ho gaye haath juda..(2)
aankh mein teer chubha, sar bhi do neem hua
roke sarwar ne kaha, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Thaame shabbir kamar, nauhagar khasta jigar
bole aye sher mere, ye na thi humko khabar
yu nibhaoge wafa, yaad kis waqt kiya..(2)
dil pe jab teer laga, aayi na hum ko qaza
bus alam khoon bhara, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek kohram utha, jab alam khoo'n mein bhara
aaya khaimo ki taraf, binte zahra ne kaha
sach tha baba ne kaha, loot jayegi rida..(2)
tab yaqee'n mujhko na tha, kis ko ab du mai sada
lashkar e zoro jafa, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye rehan o raza, din wo ashoor ka tha
lut gaye ehle haram, kat gaya sheh ka gala
qafela sham chala, lut gayi sab ki rida..(2)
koi waris na raha, ro ke zainab ne kaha
baandhne shimr gala, aagaya abbas...
<<MINI>>
ya abbas, ya abbas...(2)
saniye shere khuda, ban ke aaya hai qaza
har taraf shor utha, aagaya abbas...(3)
